series.derivation: formula-driven; the descriptor must be one of the three listed values

naming.non_series_handling: manual mapping required; naming may not be improvised
naming.colorway_noise_scope: these tokens are stripped from the PUBLIC colorway name only; they remain valid segments inside an official SKU
validators: product name must equal the manifest product_title

sku.narrowing_rationale: This pack narrows the Core set by removing stockx_code and goat_code. The Prada evidence base contains no Tier 2 or Tier 3 confirmation, so accepting those types would assert a capability this pack cannot support. Narrowing can only reduce SKU usage, never produce a wrong value.
sku.revisit_when: a Tier 2 or Tier 3 Prada confirmation is captured with exact-entity evidence
sku.always_rejected_values_rationale: These five strings were observed in source folder names but cannot be relied on as official codes (missing segments, glued segments, or O/0 ambiguity). They are rejected by value, not by type, so that a mis-typed sku_type cannot resurrect them. Rejection is recorded as SKU-PACK-REJECTED, never as absence.
sku.incomplete_code_handling: treat as source-folder residue; return to Tier 1-4 and re-read the code character by character (watch O vs 0); if unresolved, omit the SKU
sku.public_url_code_form: underscore-joined, e.g. 2EG479_D7C_F0304_F_G001; the same code may also appear without underscores, which is not a second SKU

series_requirements.note: both are mandatory; the parent alone is not sufficient

known_conflicts.description: 66 of 78 manifest SKU values were sku_type=internal_catalog (DS-PRA-001..078). Under the active V4.4 standard those are Internal IDs and must not be published as SKU.
known_conflicts.resolution: re-resolve each item to VERIFIED_SKU or SKU_OMIT

failure_taxonomy.symptom: batch suffix is the only discriminator
internal catalogue code offered as SKU
incomplete code from a source folder name

verified_success.product_name: Prada America's Cup Patent Leather Sneakers Grey White

evidence.visual_identity: public image dhash_distance = 0 and color_mae = 0 against local source image
evidence.naming: America's Cup template with descriptor = Patent Leather Sneakers

verified_success.claim_boundary: This case proves identity, naming, category placement and image provenance. It does NOT prove SKU validity (the recorded value was an internal code) and it does NOT prove V4.4 compliance.

rules.if: the product belongs to the America's Cup collection
rules.then: compose the name from the series template and accept only the three listed descriptors

rules.if: the product does not belong to America's Cup and no manual mapping exists
rules.then: stop; naming may not be improvised

rules.if: the candidate SKU matches the internal pattern DS-PRA-###
rules.then: reject the candidate and resolve to SKU_OMIT

rules.if: a colorway noise token appears in the public colorway name
rules.then: strip it from the public name only

rules.if: the candidate SKU is an incomplete code (missing segments or ambiguous characters)
rules.then: return to a Tier 1-4 source and re-read it; if unresolved, omit the SKU
require both the parent and the series category

rules.if: an existing live URL is structurally broken (leading hyphen, no brand prefix, no colorway semantics)
rules.then: migrate: old URL to a single 301 hop to the final URL
